resources.string: No video. Record one or allow library access.
Allow video access make e fit compress di last file.
Compress recordings wey you import for dis phone, change encode settings, start or wait for di queue, share di result, and check progress.
Make I clear all di jobs?

E go commot every job from Recent and Library and delete leftover cache files (imports, encode temps, and recordings wey still dey inside di app). Compressed files wey don save for Movies or Music go remain. Encodes wey dey run go cancel. Screen recording wey dey happen now, e no go touch am.
Capture di display, then compress di file.
Recording dey pause. Tap make e continue or stop.
Choose di capture area for screen.
Pick video or audio file, or share am come dis app. You fit change to audio-only for di next screen.
Pick pictures or videos with soundtrack files for one picker. Each pair go turn job, same as Share. Still picture go last as di audio.
Record, import, share, or join picture with audio make you start.
Microphone and app audio dey mix live enter one stereo track. Headphone plus echo cancel go reduce speaker echo.
Microphone na track 1 (Voice) and app audio na track 2 (System). Editors fit change speech vs game volume later. Headphone plus echo cancel still dey reduce speaker echo.
E go write two audio streams for di MP4 or WebM instead of mix dem. Ducking no dey.
E only capture playback from di app wey you select. Dat app must dey play audio during di recording.
Reduce app audio when you dey talk
E go lower internal audio as you dey talk. E dey apply live for di mix.
Ducking only dey work when mic and app audio mix enter one track.
Use di notification or di buttons below to pause or stop. If you lock di phone, capture go stop for Android 15+.
E dey wrap audio and save di recording…
Android go ask which screen or app to capture. Consent dey need every time.
Box go show for display. Drag di corners, then Record region. Na only dat rectangle e go encode.
E go stop automatically if free space no reach 200 MB, so di file fit still save.
Select rectangle after consent. E dey crop during capture so di file no go re-encode. Overlay permission dey need.
E go show camera inset on top of di recording. E go appear for di video. E need camera and overlay permission.
E dey draw ripples for taps (and cursor for mouse or stylus) while e dey record. On di accessibility service; e only dey draw overlays, e no dey read text.
E dey show tap ripples, laser pointer, or ink for screen while Recording Compressor dey capture. E no dey read on-screen text, passwords, or other content.
Small overlay with pause and stop. E go enter di video. Di notification and Quick Settings tile also dey control recording.
Allow “Display over other apps” for region, camera inset, or di floating controls, then start again.
E dey write H.264, HEVC, AV1, or VP8 (WebM) during capture and skip di second compress pass. Audio wrap without re-encode video, including separate mic and app tracks.
E stop for di maximum length.
E stop because storage almost full.
E dey use voice-communication mic path plus AcousticEchoCanceler if di phone support am.
E dey on di platform NoiseSuppressor for di microphone session.
Capture dey write VP8 + WebM. Direct encode go publish dat file; if not, e still go open for compress screen.
E go commot di camera overlay from di video until you continue.
Red dot dey follow your finger, mouse, or stylus. Na di same accessibility service as tap highlights.
Ink strokes go remain until you stop. Dem go enter di video.
If you commot di app while e dey record, small pause/stop/bookmark window go open. Di Record screen no dey need after capture start.
E dey paint black bar over di status bar for di file. You still go see notifications and privacy dots for di phone; Android no go allow app hide those.
E dey burn black-and-white picture enter di recording. Same look as Compress grayscale. Direct encode go write am for gallery file; if not, Compress go start with dis on.

After stop, e go transcribe speech for di phone with Whisper tiny and mux subtitle track. E also dey write .srt beside di file. E go skip if audio no dey. First use go download di speech model (~100 MB, Wi-Fi better). Separate notification dey show progress; Cancel there go skip captions and still save di video.

After transcribe, e go paint each cue for di frames for that time so di text go always show. E go encode di picture again; e still dey write .srt. Cancel for Transcribing notification go skip this and still keep di video.
E go keep di required recording notification as silent, low-prominence entry. E no fit hide completely.
Picture from di video, soundtrack from di second file
Video bitrate na (target × 8 / duration) minus audio and container overhead. CBR dey keep di file under di cap.
0.25 MB to 2048 MB. Discord free na 10, WhatsApp na 16 or 64, Gmail na 25.
Dis clip too long for %1$s for usable bitrate. Di file fit pass di cap.
Make e fit size dey lock CBR so di output stay near di cap.
E dey use Android Media3 Transformer and di hardware encoder. No FFmpeg.

E dey use di bundled FFmpeg build. H.264 na software (libopenh264/mpeg4) because FFmpeg h264_mediacodec dey write scrambled frames. Use di Phone engine for hardware H.264. HEVC/AV1 still fit use hardware encoder if e dey.
E dey hold di picture as VP8/VP9/AV1 + Opus WebM. Length match di soundtrack.
E dey hold di picture as MP4. Length match di soundtrack.
E dey keep di video picture and replace di soundtrack for WebM.
E dey keep di video picture and replace di soundtrack for MP4.
E dey write Opus .webm. From video e dey commot soundtrack; from audio e dey re-encode am.
E dey write AAC .m4a. From video e dey commot soundtrack; from audio e dey re-encode am.
E dey write VP8/VP9/AV1 + Opus WebM. FFmpeg dey use software libvpx for VP8/VP9. AV1 dey use di phone encoder if e dey, if not libaom. Media3 dey use di phone encoder.
E dey write compressed MP4 with video and audio.
CBR dey hold steady rate. VBR fit look better for di same average size. MediaTek phones still dey try VBR first.
E dey convert di picture to black and white for FFmpeg and Phone. Audio-only jobs dey skip am.

E dey transcribe speech for di phone with Whisper tiny (sherpa-onnx), mux subtitle track, and save .srt sidecar. Mute jobs dey skip am. First use go download di speech model (~100 MB). Separate notification dey show progress; Cancel there go skip captions and still keep di video.

E dey paint each transcribed cue for di frames for Whisper time. E go always show for any player. E go encode di picture again; e still dey save .srt. Audio-only jobs dey skip am. Cancel for Transcribing notification go skip burn and keep di video.
E go analyse di clip, then encode. Better detail for low bitrates; e take about twice as long. E dey work with VP8, VP9, software AV1, and MPEG-4. libopenh264 and hardware encoders remain one pass.
Di current FFmpeg encoder no fit do two passes. Switch to VP9 or software AV1, or turn hardware off for AV1.
Some phone H.264 encoders dey ignore profile. FFmpeg dey honour am more reliable.
Baseline get di most compatibility. High normally look better for di same bitrate.
E dey use di phone AV1 encoder. Playback need AV1-capable player. E go fall back to VP9 or H.264 if encode fail.
E dey use av1_mediacodec when hardware dey on, if not libaom-av1 if dis FFmpeg build get am. Playback need AV1-capable player.
Tone-map dey use OpenGL for di phone. Pixel 10 still dey tone-map H.264/HEVC automatically.
Tone-map dey write Rec.709 SDR tags. Full HDR mapping depend on di FFmpeg build.
E dey append after di built-in flags. Type dem yourself or describe wetin you want make Gemini write di flags. Video remain for dis phone.
e.g. flip horizontally and boost contrast small
Generate extra args (add key for Settings)
Na dis command go run. INPUT na di picture or video, AUDIO na di soundtrack, and OUTPUT na dis job file. Edit anything else, then start.
Na dis command go run. INPUT and OUTPUT na dis job files and dem no fit point elsewhere. Edit anything else, then start.
E dey use your edited command. Preset and advanced chips no go change am until you reset.
E go commot di source file only after di compressed copy don save. Gallery files, Android fit block dem.
E go export only dis range. Leave both ends for di edges for di whole video.
Extra args don fill. Review dem before you start.

You fit leave dis screen. Jobs go continue for notification, one at a time.
Apply to jobs wey dey wait
E go set di same encode options for %1$d waiting job(s). Di job wey already dey compress, e no go touch am.
E no fit delete di original file.
Recorded and imported videos and audio go show here.
No encode log yet. Run compression and di full FFmpeg or Media3 output go appear here.
Phone dey use Media3 Transformer and di hardware encoder, without FFmpeg. E apply to new jobs.
Reuse di last resolution, bitrate, and audio choices.
Start Balanced (or your remembered settings) as soon as recording stop.
Default for new jobs. Di original go commot only after di compressed file don write. Recordings wey dis app create, e fit always delete; gallery files Android fit block.
E go cancel encode only when FFmpeg no send progress for dis long. Long video fine if progress keep updating.
Agents fit list and import videos, audio, and photos wey already dey for dis phone. Choose Allow all if Android offer selected items.
E dey need so App Functions fit open file without di picker. Choose Allow all, not selected photos.
Run 1-second test encodes for each hardware encoder. E dey check di highest resolution wey actually work, 10-bit HDR support, and real-time speed.

Dis encode 1-second synthetic clip with each hardware encoder wey e detect (h264_mediacodec, hevc_mediacodec, vp9_mediacodec, av1_mediacodec, and Media3). Temp files remain for app cache and e go delete dem after.
E dey generate %1$d×%2$d test clip for %3$s
E dey try 10-bit encode on %1$s at %2$d×%3$d
E stop before every encoder finish.
E no fit generate 1-second test clip.

Optional. Free Google AI Studio key go make di compress screen turn Pidgin or English request to extra FFmpeg flags. E start with di latest Flash model and fall back to older or lighter ones if dat model no dey or rate-limit catch am. Di video file remain for dis phone; na only di text prompt and encode settings dey go Google.
Compress screen recordings for dis phone with FFmpeg or di phone encoder (Media3). Join picture or video with separate soundtrack. Files no dey upload.

Di app no dey collect accounts, analytics, or advertising identifiers. Screen recording dey use Android MediaProjection consent dialog. Microphone and internal-audio capture only dey when you on dem, mix together live or store as two tracks (voice and system) for one file. You fit limit internal audio to one app, pick phone or Bluetooth mic, apply echo cancel and noise suppress, mix mic and app audio with gain or ducking, crop region during capture, overlay camera inset, and show tap, laser, or ink highlights. Di optional overlay dey use accessibility service wey only dey draw; e no dey read text. Overlay permission dey for region selection, camera inset, and floating controls. Cover status bar dey paint enter di recording and no need dat permission. Compressed files dey write to Movies/RecordingCompressor (MP4 or WebM) or Music/RecordingCompressor (M4A or WebM audio) for dis phone. If you add Gemini API key and tap Generate extra args, di text prompt and encode settings go go Google Gemini API. Di video itself remain for di phone. For Android 16+, privileged system assistant fit list jobs, change encode settings, start or wait for work, share or open finished file, and discard history through App Functions. If you grant Device library access for Settings (Allow all), dat assistant fit also list and import videos, audio, and photos wey already dey for dis phone. E no dey receive di media files. On-device automation apps fit send broadcast to compress granted file, stop recording wey dey happen, or cancel di encode queue; completion broadcast dey report job metadata and di output URI. Automation no fit start screen capture.

Dis software dey use libraries from di FFmpeg project under LGPLv3. FFmpeg na trademark of Fabrice Bellard. Debug builds dey ship dev.ffmpegkit-maintained:ffmpeg-kit-full 8.1.7 (FFmpeg 8.1.2, LGPL-3.0). Source for those libraries dey available from di upstream projects; see docs/ffmpeg-build.md for di application source for how Play Store build suppose produce from FFmpegKitNext without GPL encoders.
Di Phone (Media3) engine dey use AndroidX Media3 Transformer and di platform MediaCodec encoders. Dat path no dey run FFmpeg.
HEVC and AV1 dey offer through di phone hardware encoder when e dey. Software AV1 dey use libaom or SVT-AV1 only if dis FFmpeg build include dem. Dis app no dey ship libx264 or libx265.
AndroidX, Kotlin, and Material libraries dey use under their Apache 2.0 licenses.
